H3003.d: the same as יָבֵשׁ (also יָבֵישׁ; often with the addition of גִּלְעָד, i.e. Jabesh of Gilad); Jobesh, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine; Jobesh (-Gilead).

H3130.d: future of יָסַף; let him add (or perhaps simply active participle adding); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites; Joseph. Compare יְהוֹסֵף.

H3263.d: from עוּץ; counsellor; Jeuts, an Israelite; Jeuz

H3444.d: feminine passive participle of יָשַׁע; something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity; deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare.

H3337.d: the same as יֵצֶר; Jetser, an Israelite; Jezer.

H3063.d: from יָדָה; celebrated; Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory; Judah.

H3200.d: patronymically from יָכִיןlemma יִכִין first vowel, corrected to יָכִין; a Jakinite (collectively) or descendants of Jakin; Jachinites.

H3446.d: from שַׁחֲצוֹם; he will laugh; Jischak, the heir of Abraham; Isaac. Compare יִצְחָק.

H3378.d: from רִיב and בַּעַל; Baal will contend; Jerubbaal, a symbolic name of Gideon; Jerubbaal.

H3478.d: from שָׂרָה and אֵל; he will rule as God; Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity; Israel.

H3079.d: from יְהֹוָה abbreviated and קוּם; Jehovah will raise; Jehojakim, a Jewish king; Jehoiakim. Compare יוֹיָקִים.

H3344.d: a primitive root; to burn; (be) burn(-ing), [idiom] from the hearth, kindle.

H3034.d: a primitive root; used only as denominative from יָד; literally, to use (i.e. hold out) the hand; physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands); cast (out), (make) confess(-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank(-ful, -s, -sgiving).

H3411.d: feminine of יָרֵךְ; properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess; border, coast, part, quarter, side.

H3364.d: a primitive root; to awake (intransitive); (be) awake(-d).

H3431.d: from שָׁבַח; he will praise; Jishbach, an Israelite; Ishbah.

H3243.d: a primitive root; to suck; causatively, to give milk; milch, nurse(-ing mother), (give, make to) suck(-ing child, -ling).

H3255.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to יָסַף; {to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)}; add.

H3185.d: from חָצָהlemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה and אֵל; allotted of God; Jachtsiel, an Israelite; Jahziel. Compare יַחְצְאֵל.

H3252.d: from an unused root meaning to watch; observant; Jiskah, sister of Lot; Iscah.

H3416.d: from רָפָא and אֵל; God will heal; Jirpeel, a place in Palestine; Irpeel.
